title: Bow aim experiment 2: three ways (P, Q, R)
intro: No reset needed; leave 'Limit the bow-aim zoom' unticked. Clear view. Hold the bow aim for about 20 s. Remember which letters changed the view and whether the aim point moved.

steps.text: Co-op OFF. HOLD the bow aim (right mouse) until the end. Press End while aiming

steps.each_frame:
if not AIMY then
  AIMY = { mode = "", n = 0 }
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.AimCameraController")
  local m = td:get_method("onUpdate")
  AIMY.has = m ~= nil
  if m then
    sdk.hook(m, function(args) thread.get_hook_storage().this = sdk.to_managed_object(args[2]) end,
      function(ret)
        pcall(function()
          local o = thread.get_hook_storage().this
          AIMY.n = AIMY.n + 1
          local p, g = o:get_field("_Position"), o:get_field("_Pog")
          local dx, dy, dz = p.x - g.x, p.y - g.y, p.z - g.z
          local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
          AIMY.pogdist = l
          if AIMY.mode == "P" and l > 0.01 then
            p.x, p.y, p.z = p.x + dx / l * 3.0, p.y + dy / l * 3.0, p.z + dz / l * 3.0; o:set_field("_Position", p)
          end
          if AIMY.mode == "Q" then o:set_field("_Fov", 90.0) end
          if AIMY.mode == "R" and l > 0.01 then
            p.x, p.y, p.z = p.x + dx / l * 3.0, p.y + dy / l * 3.0, p.z + dz / l * 3.0; o:set_field("_Position", p)
            g.x, g.y, g.z = g.x + dx / l * 3.0, g.y + dy / l * 3.0, g.z + dz / l * 3.0; o:set_field("_Pog", g)
          end
        end)
        return ret
      end)
  end
end

probes.ctrl: local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController'); return c and (c:get_type_definition():get_name()..' '..tostring(c:call('get_BaseDistance'))) or 'nil'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.cfov: local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController'); return c and c:get_field('_Fov')
probes.calls: return AIMY and (tostring(AIMY.has)..' n='..tostring(AIMY.n)..' pogdist='..string.format('%.2f', AIMY.pogdist or -1))
probes.aimset:
if AIMSET_DONE then return nil end
local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController')
if not c or c:get_type_definition():get_name() ~= 'AimCameraController' then return nil end
local function dump(o) if not o then return 'nil' end local t={} local td=o:get_type_definition() while td and td:get_full_name()~='System.Object' do for _,f in ipairs(td:get_fields()) do if not f:is_static() then local ok,v=pcall(o.get_field,o,f:get_name()); local s=tostring(v); if ok and type(v)=='userdata' then local okx,sx=pcall(function() return string.format('(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f)',v.x,v.y,v.z) end); s=okx and sx or (pcall(function() return v:get_type_definition():get_full_name() end) and v:get_type_definition():get_full_name() or s) end t[#t+1]=f:get_name()..'='..s end end td=td:get_parent_type() end return o:get_type_definition():get_full_name()..': '..table.concat(t,' | ') end
AIMSET_DONE = true
return dump(c:get_field('_CurrentAimSetting'))..' ## '..dump(c:get_field('_AimCameraSetting'))
